_doc: Allow-list for scripts/dash-audit.mjs --check. Each entry: path (repo-relative or, for scope export, relative to the export root; one * wildcard per segment allowed), max (the most dashes tolerated there), reason (why the dash cannot become a hyphen), scope (source | export, default source). An entry that matches nothing is STALE and fails the check, so the list can only shrink. --fix never edits an allow-listed file.

allow.reason: OWNER-PINNED approved shopper-demo file (docs/approved-shopper-demo.json, test:launch-invariants). One en dash (U+2013) in an aria-hidden position glyph (line ~179, never read by a screen reader, shown only on the hidden rows of the 'Frequently bought together' demo). Changing it is an owner-review action (--update-pins); the ready patch is dash-cleanup/fbt-demo-glyph.patch. Delete this entry when the owner approves the patch.
